## Breaking API major 2026-03-25.dahlia (current supported major before Endive) [Not affected]

### Change

No code changes. The repo pins 2025-11-17.clover (stripe-node 20.0.0, lib/billing/stripe.ts:16) and does not move to dahlia. I checked every dahlia breaking change against the code and none of them touches it. I did not run the repo checks, because no files were edited.

No files changed.

### Why

Dahlia's breaking items are all outside this repo's usage. The Checkout `ui_mode` enum change doesn't apply because `checkout.sessions.create` never sets `ui_mode`. The Stripe.js, Elements, Connect capabilities, Issuing and event-destination items aren't used here. The one item that touches a response shape is the new retention-policy value for subscription `cancellation_details.reason`. Nothing in `app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts` or the cancel route reads `cancellation_details`. The webhook handlers only read `status`, `metadata`, `items`, `customer` and `cancel_at_period_end`. `stripe_check_params` found no problems for `checkout.sessions.create` or `subscriptions.update` against the 2026-03-25.dahlia spec.

> As the first version in the Dahlia release, `2026-03-25.dahlia` introduces both breaking changes and new features

Source: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/dahlia.md

### Proof

| Check | Before | After | New failures |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| typecheck | fail (283) | fail (283) | 0 |
| build | fail (1) | fail (1) | 0 |
| test | fail (204) | fail (204) | 0 |

New failures: 0

Provider tool calls recorded by the harness:
- `stripe__stripe_api_versions`: pass
- `stripe__stripe_check_params`: pass
- `stripe__stripe_check_params`: pass

The agent's validator claims (not proof; graded against the recorded calls):
- stripe__stripe_api_versions: pass (Listed 11 breaking entries between 2025-11-17.clover and 2026-03-25.dahlia. None applies to the repo's calls.)
- stripe__stripe_check_params: pass (checkout.sessions.create and subscriptions.update params checked against the 2026-03-25.dahlia spec (v2248) with no problems found. I did not run the check on customers.create, billingPortal.sessions.create or coupons.create.)

Where checks ran: Docker container node:22-bookworm; install scripts disabled; no host env or mounts besides the repo copy

### Unproven

- Which API version the dashboard webhook endpoint uses. I can't read that from the repo. Existing endpoints keep their own api_version and only change if they are recreated.
- The pin was not moved to dahlia and no runtime test was run against it. The stripe-node 20.0.0 types only accept the clover literal, so a real move needs an SDK bump.
- The baseline typecheck, build and test failures were already there and I did not look into them.
- typecheck was already failing before the change and still fails.
- build was already failing before the change and still fails.
- test was already failing before the change and still fails.

### Behaviour changes

None intended.

36	export async function getOrCreateStripeCustomer(

42	  const subscription = await prisma.subscription.findUnique({
